front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original 16-part skeletal game character atlas.
Primary request: Rebuild the Ashen Hidewall from reference 1 as original modern high-end game art, exploded into separate body components for continuous animation. Reference 1 establishes identity; reference 2 provides the modular 4 by 4 layout and visual quality only. This is the Hidewall, a distinct man from the Raider in reference 2.
Character: exceptionally broad, massive adult male shield bearer with thick powerful limbs, square weathered tan face, heavy dark beard with small braided strands, dark hair tied in a high compact topknot. Black and brown leather cuirass beneath a thick coarse fur shoulder yoke, warm tan fur on anatomical RIGHT shoulder and charcoal dark fur on anatomical LEFT shoulder; bone and tooth necklace across chest. Rust-red cloth waist sash, worn leather belt, layered dark hide hip strips with pale fur patches; practical dark trousers, heavy russet leather boots with broad pale fur cuffs. His familiar large wooden oval shield and mace are NOT part of these body sheets: no weapon or shield baked anywhere.
View: FRONT facing camera, elevated 25 degrees, orthographic. Premium realistic 3D rendered game surfaces, beautifully tactile fur, skin, bone and leather; strong believable anatomy, no outlines, no pixel art. Soft warm upper-left light and cool ambient bounce.
Composition: exactly 16 separate parts in regular 4 columns by 4 rows. Entire pieces centered independently with generous transparent gutters, no assembled person. All limb segments point straight DOWN from root joint to tip joint, no elbow bends baked into surface. Smooth round overlap joint ends, no internal anatomy.
Row1: complete front head and neck including beard/topknot, no loose long hair; sleeveless torso from shoulders to waist including short upper fur yoke and necklace but NO arms or head; hip garment including belt/sash/hide panels but NO legs; separate broad dark fur back-cape panel from shoulder blades to waist, hanging downward, no neck or torso.
Row2: anatomical LEFT upper arm shoulder-to-elbow; RIGHT upper arm shoulder-to-elbow; LEFT leather bracer forearm elbow-to-wrist NO hand; RIGHT leather bracer forearm NO hand.
Row3: LEFT softly closed gripping hand plus wrist; RIGHT softly closed gripping hand plus wrist; exactly ONE LEFT trouser thigh from hip to knee; exactly ONE RIGHT trouser thigh. Each thigh is one isolated leg segment, never shorts or both legs in one cell.
Row4: LEFT trouser shin knee-to-ankle; RIGHT trouser shin knee-to-ankle; LEFT fur-cuffed leather boot with toe toward camera; RIGHT fur-cuffed leather boot with toe toward camera.
Hands: natural neutral rotation, gently closed grips around an invisible handle, thumb/index curl makes a small clear empty opening for the tool shaft; all other fingers curled, not spread or dangling straight.
Torso constraints: no visible bare skin shoulder circles or holes in the detached torso. Shoulder attachment is covered by clothing/fur, and the separate upper arm surface supplies the skin.
No weapons, tools, shield, cargo, scenery, floor, drop shadows, labels, text, grid or checkerboard. Genuine transparent PNG with alpha zero in all blank space.

transparentExtraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet
Primary request: Extract all separate character components from the supplied image onto a genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel.
Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep every component and its placement, detail, color, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the painted checkerboard background. Preserve clean edges and all gaps. The output is a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on paper.
